create_regression_data: create synthetic regression data with make_regression specifying samples, features, and informative columns
build_ridge_model: build a Ridge regression model and train it across a range of L2 regularization strengths
test_coefficient_error: test Ridge coefficient accuracy by computing mean squared error against true coefficients
plot_ridge_coefficients: plot Ridge coefficients as a function of regularization strength on a log scale
plot_mean_squared_error: plot mean squared error between estimated and true Ridge coefficients as alpha varies
